data_policy.exact_signal_deduplication: sha256_of_raw_waveform_file_before_split; keep one deterministic representative; remove cross-partition duplicates from validation/calibration/source-holdout

rhythm.label_source: PhysioNet/CinC Challenge 2021 SNOMED-CT Dx header statements
rhythm.mapping_basis: Challenge 2021 scored SNOMED mappings; CRBBB/IRBBB with RBBB, SVPB with PAC, and VPB with PVC
rhythm.cpsc2018_split: entire available public training-source copy used for training only; patient identifiers unavailable; no within-source evaluation

development_source_holdout.policy: entire available source held out; remove exact duplicate waveform files and records present in the prior public V4.5 evaluation manifest before scoring
development_source_holdout.patient_ids: unavailable; any reported interval is record-clustered, not patient-grouped

preprocessing.candidate_path: prepare_rhythm_record; fixed 125 Hz, 10 s windows with existing waveform contract

window_aggregation.training_window_weight: each ECG contributes total weight 1 regardless of window count

pathology.source: PTB-XL v1.0.3 SCP-ECG statements and official patient folds
pathology.negative_control_rule: explicit NORM likelihood > 0 and no P4 target code present with positive or zero likelihood
pathology.unknown_rule: unannotated, zero-likelihood, and non-control rows are masked, never converted to negative

split.fold_9: patient-grouped 50/50 threshold_calibration and internal_evaluation split using stable patient-id hash

preprocessing.candidate_path: prepare_p4_record; fixed 125 Hz, first 10 s window

loss_comparison.weighted_bce: source-balanced elements and training-only negative/positive ratio clipped to [1, 10]
loss_comparison.focal: source-balanced elements, gamma=2, positive alpha from training-only weighted class prevalence

candidate_training.selection_rule: primary candidate is fixed before holdout scoring; ablations are descriptive and never selected using Georgia, CPSC, or PTB-XL fold-9 evaluation
candidate_training.leave_one_source_out_sensitivity: one additional fixed weighted-BCE seed-20261111 rhythm model trains on Chapman plus eligible Georgia rows and evaluates CPSC; exclude previously public V4.5 Georgia rows and exact duplicates; not independent validation
candidate_training.optuna: not_run_for_bounded_fixed_architecture_stage_A; no search until the predeclared pilot is reviewed

thresholds.candidate: per-class F1 maximization on the separate calibration split; ties choose the highest threshold

statistics.grouping: patient when a validated patient key exists; otherwise ECG record and explicitly not patient-level

success_targets_not_guarantees.external_independent_validation: NOT_RUN unless a separately eligible and unexposed cohort is demonstrated
